pillar_reactions.evidence: Took notes and asked the rep to repeat the structure back: 'you said three to four times a week. And then you said, how much time?' and 'And then you said 25 minutes in the beginning.' He engaged with the mechanism rather than the promise, consistent with his stated need to understand the method before committing.

This was his stated primary want and he agreed without pushback — 'Do you feel like, yeah, that's something I can stick to? — Yeah, sure.' He had already put a number on its importance himself: 'when it comes down to the objectives that I want, nutrition is like 70%.' Notably he asked for macros and the rep told him 'overall Trevor isn't that big into counting', and he did not object to that.

Agreed to the video-feedback and check-in loop — 'if he asked me to do it, yeah' — and confirmed the weekly form and Thursday live workouts with 'Check? — Yes. Perfect.' He qualified it with a preference for autonomy rather than an objection: 'being also at some point independent is something that I will look for.'

anchors.raw: I usually try some fitness programs online every maybe four months, you know, and I never tried the kettlebell technique or program
anchors.note: His entire reference class for buying fitness is low-cost online programmes bought three times a year and abandoned. $6,000 for six months is a category change, not a price increase, and the rep never repositioned it against that history.

anchors.raw: It was always, you know, looking at videos, trying to learn myself, you know, okay, how many grams of protein you need per kilo? Okay, creatine right now, it's very trendy
anchors.note: He has been getting a partially working result for free from YouTube and his own reading. He says the free version is incomplete, which is the opening, but the free substitute is still the live comparison in his head.

anchors.raw: Actually, you know, I feel that I improved doing all these programs, you know. Each time, you know, it will bring me to a better, you know, a better state
anchors.note: Every previous cheap programme did produce progress in his telling. That weakens the case that the expensive one is the necessary next step and the rep did not challenge it — he accepted 'they've all worked, you've seen progression, but you've never gone to the peak'.

anchors.raw: we have an investment of 6k USD, and your currency is Morrocodirham, right?... So it's around 56.
anchors.note: The rep converted the price into roughly 56,000 dirham on the call, restating it as a much larger-looking number in the prospect's own currency immediately before the deliberation began.

anchors.raw: It's not because you have money that you just throwing money, money, money around. So you always have to wait in all your decisions. And this is what makes people like that successful.
anchors.note: He anchored his own identity to deliberate spending, which converts any urgency push into an attack on the trait he credits for his success. The rep pushed against it anyway.

unmet_demand.want: To pay progressively while testing the method, rather than wiring a large sum to a provider he has not verified
unmet_demand.why_unmet: The offer is a single six-month commitment paid upfront, or an unofficial plan; there is no sanctioned trial or escrow-style arrangement, so the rep invented a one-month $1,200 trial with a walk-away and interest-bearing instalments on the spot.

unmet_demand.want: Explicit macro numbers and macro tracking confirmed by an expert
unmet_demand.why_unmet: He asked for exactly this twice — 'I never reached to someone to tell me exactly, in terms of macros' — and was told 'overall Trevor isn't that big into counting, it really comes down to just having a protocol'. His stated core need and the programme's stated method point in different directions.

He plays three times a week and framed his back concern around golf specifically. The programme's mobility work plausibly serves this, but nobody connected it — golf was mentioned only as a scheduling constraint.

unmet_demand.want: Evidence he can compare against alternatives on success rate
unmet_demand.why_unmet: He asked to 'decide based on the different options and also based on the success rate of each option' and received an unquantified claim, 'we've got massive amounts of results from people who have gotten to that peak'. No case, number or comparable was offered.
